record_title: Support-containment obstruction in a published length-24 ternary trifferent-code witness
provenance: An exact coding-theoretic certificate showing that the 6x24 matrix printed as a ternary trifferent inner code in a 2024 JLMS construction has two codewords with strictly nested supports and is therefore not trifferent.
limitations: The result invalidates only the displayed matrix as a trifferent witness. It does not prove that no [24,6]_3 trifferent code exists, does not determine b_3^*(6,1), and does not by itself refute the existence statement of the cited asymptotic theorem; a corrected witness could repair the proof. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from an unindexed correction.
